hypotheses.Q1_diagonal4_sufficiency: At shared dimension 4, diagonal-only squared coordinates stay within 0.05 median AUROC of the full restricted quadratic forms on every corpus.
hypotheses.Q2_diagonal32_sufficiency: At shared dimension 32, diagonal-only squared coordinates stay within 0.05 median AUROC of the full restricted forms on every corpus.
hypotheses.Q3_cross_term_state_variance: At dimension 32, cross terms contribute at least 25% of restricted-score variance on every corpus.
hypotheses.Q4_cross_term_semantic_gain: At dimension 32, full cross-term forms improve median AUROC over diagonal-only forms by at least 0.02 on at least two corpora.
